source.scope: Original continuous ordinary main-loop branch 0x4a63d2..0x4a69e8: complete contacts, component/cooldown, initial shared forces, roll target, subsequent mount world-position reads, wheel levers and front contact axis. Finite synthetic state and terrain, four-node parent/child graphs with all mount pairings and aliasing, speed/angle boundaries and signed-zero cases. Pinned Wine 11 D3DRM. Initial query scratch and exit observation boundaries supplied. Later chassis-contact probes, force assembly and whole-bike trajectories excluded.
